review.scope: Maintainer review of the exact public npm archive: identity, version, SHA512, SHA1, compressed byte length, exported entry points, browser UI presence and dependency metadata; public bytes match the frozen local release archive. Source commit ea5b813911fd2567096acc416cfc2c0608eff0c0 passed make check (11,288 TypeScript tests and 134 Rust tests), make build and forty-package packed installation on macOS ARM64. Six infra-local native targets passed architecture, digest and assembly checks. Windows artifacts were cross-compiled; Windows runtime acceptance remains pending. Linux x64 Docker builds are build evidence and do not establish native-machine runtime acceptance. Catalog support remains darwin/arm64 and linux/x64 within the accepted maintainer release scope. Compatibility requires product >=1.0.4, with no maximum version bound. Staged compatibility acceptance passed on macOS ARM64 with a fresh public npm global installation of @eum-agent/cli@1.0.4 and all fourteen public default extension archives at 1.0.1, using committed catalog snapshot 600b6a2e3c39bd0bdbf9e74fdf699ea78601b758 through narrowly intercepted GitHub catalog requests; npm downloads remained public. Exactly twenty-two built-ins and fourteen defaults were installed, and all thirty-six plugins activated. Authenticated instance-bound shutdown observed actual child close, exit status zero and consumed natural output EOF. This staged result does not establish live GitHub catalog delivery or Linux/Windows runtime acceptance. Paid provider calls, exhaustive dependency security audits and other target runtime acceptance are outside this review. Source is private; commit binding is maintainer supplied. No npm provenance or GitHub Actions evidence is claimed.
